title: Mac sync setup: owner enters the server address and invite code; Claude only stages the address
context: Owner 2026-10-14: "Fill out the Server Link and Invite code on my Mac." The fields are Server address and Invite code in Settings, Start syncing (lib/features/sync/ui/start_sync_flow.dart). The installed 1.0.2 is a release build with no VM service, and Claude has no keyboard control of the owner's Mac. An invite code is an access token for the production relay https://sync.satanshu.tech (docs/deploy/relay.md, fn-relay).
options: Put https://sync.satanshu.tech on the clipboard and hand both fields to the owner, with the invite create command and the join-instead-of-invite check
Type both values into the app through UI scripting
Mint a new invite on the production relay and enter it
option_reasons: Stays within the rule that Claude never enters tokens into fields and needs no input grant
Entering an access token into a field is prohibited even on request, and HID input needs a per-session grant and Accessibility access Claude may not add
Same token rule, and an invite creates a new journal, which is wrong if another device already syncs to that relay
outcome: Copied https://sync.satanshu.tech to the Mac clipboard; told the owner to paste it, to use an existing invite or run `docker exec "$relay" /app/bin/relay invite create --note "U+003Cname>"` on the Arch server, and to join the existing journal instead if a device already syncs there.
